questions.question: Through the priest Zechariah, God told Judah that because they had left the LORD, He had left them. True or false?
As the priest Zechariah lay dying after King Joash had him stoned, what did he ask the LORD to do?

answers.text: See this and call Joash to account
Forgive Joash for what he had done

questions.question: Why did King Joash's own servants plot against him and kill him?

answers.text: For killing the son of the priest Jehoiada
For losing a war against Aram
For taxing the people to repair the temple

questions.question: After his servants killed King Joash, he was buried in the tombs of the kings. True or false?
